title: Primmel SST composite package manifest (overlay)
description: An overlay applied on top of package-manifest.schema.json when the manifest carries a 'composition' block. Validates the composite shape: components, decomposition totality, state rule, optional couplings.

source_of_truth.description: The authority this SST composite projects (e.g. primmel:acme-cgm-system@2026).

instance.description: Path (relative to this package) to the component instance package.

decomposition.description: Maps each composite register to its source (component.register). Every composite register must be sourced exactly once (totality is checked in the loader, not by the schema — the schema validates key shape only).

additionalProperties.description: component_id.register_name (e.g. analyzer.indicationCo) OR <computed>.rule_name for runtime-computed registers (e.g. operationalState).

state_rule.description: The composite state rule. Registered rules live in the runtime's state-rule registry; package-authored code is forbidden.

state_rule_args.description: Optional arguments to the state rule (e.g. the named component for any_fault_else_named).

couplings.description: Per-tick couplings between components. Each entry names a source port and a target port; the runtime reads source after each tick and writes to target before the next.
